<div style="border:2px solid #c90; background:#fff8e1; padding:0.6em 1em; margin-bottom:1em;">'''Test page.''' This is a list of possible jokes that are not on [[Jokes]], kept here so Bill can judge each one. It is not part of the main wiki.</div>

All the medium-strength candidates, the grouped ones and the rest, have moved to [[Jokes]] (26 October 2026), and so have the weaker readings that Bill picked: [[Boelo]], [[Han's Back]] and the other Back cards, [[Ewok Log Jam]], [[Blow Parried]], [[Battle Droid Officer]], [[General Jar Jar]], [[Captain Tarpals]] and [[Nien Nunb]]. The cantina band, [[Res Luk Ra'auf]] and [[Bog-wing (Dark)|Bog-wing]] moved there too, the first two as [[Jokes#type-running-gag|Running gags]]. What is left is the weaker readings not yet added, and the new candidates from the round 13 card scan. Types follow [[Jokes#Jokes by type|Jokes]].

== New candidates from the round 13 card scan ==
These come from a read of the lore, titles and game text of the 2,204 Decipher cards that are not yet on [[Jokes]], the lists above, [[Easter eggs]], [[Anagrams]] or [[Talk:Jokes]]. Running gags across several cards are left out here. Quotes are from the cards' wiki pages. They have no pictures yet.

=== Strong ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Card !! Text !! Reading !! Type and fit
|-
| [[Ubrikkian 9000 Z001]] || Title || "Ubrikkian" is close to Kubrick, "9000" is the number of HAL 9000 and "Z001" reads as 2001, so the title points to Stanley Kubrick's ''2001: A Space Odyssey''<ref name="wook-9000z001">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/9000_Z001_landspeeder/Legends 9000 Z001 landspeeder], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260412101315/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/9000_Z001_landspeeder/Legends Internet Archive], 12 April 2026.</ref><ref name="wp-hal9000">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HAL_9000 HAL 9000], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023094233/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HAL_9000 Internet Archive], 23 October 2026.</ref> || Pop-culture reference. The name is older than the card: it was in ''Star Wars Blueprints'' (1977), and Pablo Hidalgo noted the Kubrick link.<ref name="wook-9000z001" /> It sits with [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138]].
|-
| [[Solo Han]] || "If Han is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny." || The title turns "Han Solo" around, and the game text has Han fighting solo || Wordplay
|-
| [[The Bith Shuffle]] || Lore: "play at the Cantina with a distinctive rocking motion". Game text: "Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile or Used Pile." || A shuffle is a dance, and the card shuffles a deck. [[Ommni Box]], another band card, has the same game text. || Wordplay or design gag
|-
| [[Return Of A Jedi]] || "'Where did you dig up that old fossil?' ... 'Oh, he's not dead, not yet.' Obi's back!" || The title is ''Return of the Jedi'' with one word changed. The lore ends with the same "back" line as [[Han's Back]] and the other Back cards. || Film in-joke. Could join the Back cards on [[Jokes]].
|-
| [[Motti]] || "Has a disturbing lack of faith." || Vader's line to Motti, "I find your lack of faith disturbing", turned into a fact about Motti<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260720032511/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Internet Archive], 20 July 2026.</ref> || Film in-joke. The same lore also calls him "an overrated '''leader'''".
|-
| [[Ghoel]] || "Mistakenly left in Jabba's palace. No one suspects its intelligence. Often tries to lick passersby." || Three flat lines that end on the licking || Deadpan lore
|-
| [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Dark)|Magnetic Suction Tube]] (Dark Side) || "'Slurp.'" || The whole lore is a sound effect. The Light Side card says Jawas use the tube to suck up droids "(and anything else that's not nailed down)". || Deadpan lore. The pair could go together.
|-
| [[Podracer Collision]] || "Podracing demands constant attention to many variables as well as all opponents. Failure to do so can often result in reduced performance." || A crash called "reduced performance" || Deadpan lore
|}

|-
